touches.text: A device talks to other devices only over the bus, never by importing them.
The bus is the only door, with exceptions (Akien 2026-10-22). Each is a client tool the device publishes:
The bus handles two kinds of requests:
The shims, in the same process with the bus, pick up the messages and route them to their device in whatever manner is appropriate.
One bus per cairn instance (not per host). The bus owns cross system communication: extending the bus services to other host systems so we can run multiple heavy tasks at once.
The shims handle all interfacing with the outside world (ruling 2026-09-11): a device that needs to speak a foreign protocol (eg OpenAI's wire format) does it in its shim.
Its shim delivers mail to CC and pokes an idle session awake (proved 2026-10-17: woken in 8.6 s).

Will have its own email account (for CC, not Igor's; created 2026-10-26 as cc0atcairn@gmail.com; its credentials are at ~/.cairn/devices/cc/0/.env, the only record). Its shim fetches the mail, since shims handle all interfacing with the outside world (5.7.3.8). CC never checks the mailbox itself.
bus_client: gets a process onto the bus (reach a device, or connect).

open_questions.text: A sync request to a device whose shim must wake it: how long does the caller wait before it gets "not now" back? (V1 had 600 s then a trouble, before the wake moved to the shim, 5.7.3.2.2.)
Does the shim ever stop its device when idle (eg the librarian after N minutes unused), or only on `stop`?
CC's own memory (~/.claude/projects/.../memory) is Claude Code's, not Cairn's. Should it berth under ~/.cairn/devices/cc/0/ eventually, or stay where Claude Code puts it?
"Tickets on our repos": GitHub issues and pull requests on the public repos (eg CC0AC-Weather), or Cairn's own tickets too?
One face, `connect_system`, also beats. Under 5.5 nothing but the ground loop beats. Remove that face?
